annotation.bound_parties_text: The guidance is non-binding and only encourages organizations such as OEMs, equipment suppliers and service providers to follow its principles.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Cyber Guidance provides technology neutral and non-prescriptive guiding principles to strengthen cyber security throughout the vehicle lifecycle.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: They should not be construed as a technical standard or considered an exhaustive solution for vehicle cyber security.
